_comment: Embedding model registry for session-corpus G7+. Each entry declares the full migration contract.
_doc: Add an entry here before changing MODEL_ID in embed.py. schema_version_required must match the vec_embeddings DDL dims. HF market snapshot: 2026-05-04. Live audit: 2026-05-05 (see anno_2026_* fields + gating_queue). Granite R2 multilingual models added 2026-05-05. Gating queue corrected 2026-05-05: CohereForAI org rebranded to CohereLabs (models now public, moved to registry); google/text-embedding-004 confirmed API-only (no HF weights, removed from queue). 24 models total.
_gating_note: gated field: false=open, 'auto'=HF agree-terms API (programmatic OK), 'form'=manual web form (Playwright fallback). embed_gate_accept.py handles acceptance. Check gating_type before setting a model active.
_gpu_note: All models tagged text-embeddings-inference are TEI-compatible (Flash Attn 2, ONNX/TRT backend, dynamic batching on RTX 4090). sentence-transformers device=cuda works for all with torch 2.11.0+cu128 (G3 admitted). Remove TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 from embed.py when switching (HF token: esabbr, live-valid).
hardware_optimized_rationale: RTX 4090 24GB + TensorRT strategic vantage: NV-Embed-v2 is built on NVIDIA hardware primitives — Flash Attn 2, cuBLAS GEMM, TRT INT8 quantization (~8GB working set). Best absolute MTEB in registry: 69.32. 4096d native; TEI dim-truncation to 1024d preserves schema v4 — zero rebuild cost. Designed specifically for NVIDIA inference backends. When G7 re-embed is run on hardware with TensorRT available, NV-Embed-v2 is the trainstop model. Switch with: bun run embed:switch NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2. If staying on schema v4, set dim_truncation: 1024 in TEI server config.
schema_v4_dim_truncation_path: TEI: --pooling lasttoken --dtype float16 with truncation dim=1024. sentence-transformers: model.encode(texts, normalize_embeddings=True)[:, :1024]. DDL_VEC FLOAT[1024] preserved.
anno_2026_urca_de_lima: Live HF audit 2026-05-05 + gate verification: NV-Embed-v2 was registry-best at inception (MTEB 69.32, NVIDIA TRT). Open GOLD: Qwen3-Embedding-8B (Apache-2.0, already in registry as recommended_next — treasure was already aboard). GATED GOLD chase: Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2.5-7B-instruct returns 404 from public API even with auth token — org-private or unpublished, DEFERRED. REAL gated gem: google/embeddinggemma-300m — 8.5M downloads, Gemma3-text arch, TEI-compatible, arxiv:2509.20354 (Sep 2025), 302M params, 768d. Was already in registry AND user_accepted:true for esabbr account. The Urca De Lima: both the open GOLD (Qwen3-8B) and the unlocked gated gem (EmbeddingGemma-300M) were already aboard — no new gating chase needed.
anno_2026_hardware_optimized_note: hardware_optimized = NV-Embed-v2 (TRT-native, NVIDIA silicon advantage). anno_2026_gold_open = Qwen3-8B (absolute MTEB SOTA, zero licensing friction). These are DIFFERENT axes. For G7 re-embed: Qwen3-8B is the pragmatic GOLD (Apache-2.0, no ungate needed, TEI-compatible). NV-Embed-v2 is the TRT-hardware-optimal pick when NVIDIA inference stack is active.

gating_queue.rationale: DEFERRED 2026-05-05. HF public API returns 404 even with authenticated HF token (esabbr). Model may be org-private, temporarily withdrawn, or path incorrect. HF MCP tool returned 403/auth-required but embed_gate_accept.py checks confirm 404. Cannot ungate via Tier 1 or Tier 3 without direct Alibaba NLP org access.

REMOVED 2026-05-05. Cohere rebranded org from CohereForAI → CohereLabs. This path no longer exists on HF. Public successor CohereLabs/Cohere-embed-multilingual-v3.0 (1024d, 57K downloads) added directly to models section — no gating required.

DEAD 2026-05-05. This model is API-only (Vertex AI / Google AI Studio). There are no downloadable HF weights — the path never had a checkpoint. Not a gating issue; it simply does not exist on HF. Public Google embedding is google/embeddinggemma-300m (already in registry). Remove this entry after next audit cycle.

2026-05-05 re-verified: still auth-gated — HF MCP returns auth-required. All Mistral Embed variants (Mistral-Embed, Mistral-Embed-v1, Mistral-Embed-2025) are gated. Ungate enables multilingual_commercial task profile when available.

sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.notes: Offline-cached baseline. Chosen from local cache (HF token unavailable at G7 build time). Not benchmarked — convenience selection. Suitable for short-text similarity; NOT optimised for code retrieval. 256 token hard cap truncates session texts.

nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5.notes: Matryoshka dims 64-768. ModernBERT-style arch. 8192 ctx captures full session texts. Apache-2.0. Updated Apr 2026. Strong English retrieval baseline.

BAAI/bge-m3.notes: Dense + sparse + colbert hybrid. Multilingual (xlm-roberta base). 142.8M downloads — most battle-tested embedding model on HF. ONNX available. arxiv:2402.03216.

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B.notes: RECOMMENDED NEXT. #1 trending embedding model May 2026. 43.7M downloads. Apache-2.0. 32k ctx. Matryoshka (use 512d to halve schema cost). SOTA MTEB 2025-06 (arxiv:2506.05176). sentence-transformers + TEI compatible. Fits RTX 4090 VRAM with bs=32 in FP16. Requires HF token to download. Remove TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 before first run.

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B.notes: Middle tier. ~8GB VRAM in FP16. 2560d native, Matryoshka. Better accuracy than 0.6B.

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B.notes: Max accuracy tier. ~15GB VRAM in FP16 (fits RTX 4090 24GB with room for batching). 4096d or truncate to 1024d via Matryoshka. Best MTEB scores in the family.

jinaai/jina-embeddings-v3.notes: Task-aware: query, passage, classification, separation modes. 1139 likes. CC-BY-NC (non-commercial only — NOT suitable for production embedding of proprietary session data without license review).

nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2.notes: NVIDIA's production embedding model. MMTEB-competitive. Updated Mar 2026. TEI + sentence-transformers. 'license:other' — read NVIDIA terms before use. Multilingual. 4096d native.

google/embeddinggemma-300m._anno_2026_urca: REAL URCA DE LIMA: already in registry AND already unlocked. Download immediately — no gate action needed.
google/embeddinggemma-300m.notes: GATED (Gemma license) — BUT user_accepted:true for esabbr account (2026-05-05). 8.5M downloads. 1627 likes. Gemma license is non-commercial by default — review before embedding proprietary session data. arxiv:2509.20354 (Sep 2025). Gemma3-text 302M arch finetuned for sentence-similarity. TEI-compatible. 768d, schema v4 compatible. Strong small-model embed performance. IMMEDIATELY DOWNLOADABLE — no gate acceptance needed for this account.

ibm-granite/granite-embedding-small-engl.notes: ModernBERT architecture (2025 encoder refresh). Apache-2.0. Same dims as current baseline so zero schema migration. Strong English + code retrieval benchmarks (arxiv:2508.21085). Fast inference — encoder-only, no causal overhead. Underrated pick if upgrade budget is zero.

ibm-granite/granite-embedding-311m-multi.notes: NEW 2026-04-29. ModernBERT, 22-layer, 262K multilingual vocab (Gemma3 tokenizer base). Replaces granite-embedding-278m-multilingual (+11.8 MTEB multi). 52 enhanced languages + code retrieval (Py/Go/Java/JS/PHP/Ruby/SQL/C/C++). Matryoshka 768→128 with graceful degradation. Flash Attn 2, ONNX + OpenVINO shipped. TRT-compatible via ONNX-RT CUDA backend. Apache-2.0, commercial-friendly. schema v4 (768d < 1024d — DDL_VEC dynamic handles this; requires --rebuild if switching from 1024d model). task_profile: multilingual_granite_large

ibm-granite/granite-embedding-97m-multil.notes: NEW 2026-04-29. Pruned from 311m-r2 (22→12 layers, 262K→180K vocab). Highest MTEB multilingual retrieval of any open model under 100M params (59.6 vs next-best multilingual-e5-small 50.9 = +8.7). 52 enhanced languages + code retrieval. Flash Attn 2, ONNX + OpenVINO. ~2,900 docs/sec on H100 — RTX 4090 throughput similarly excellent. Apache-2.0. schema v3 (384d = zero schema change from baseline). task_profile: multilingual_granite_small. Best pick for latency-sensitive multilingual workloads.

Cohere/Cohere-embed-multilingual-v3.0._gated_live_check: 2026-05-04 — HF API returns gated:false; openly accessible without agree-terms
Cohere/Cohere-embed-multilingual-v3.0.notes: GATED (agree-terms). Leading multilingual embedding model — 100+ languages. 1024d. MTEB multilingual top-tier. TEI-compatible, ONNX export available. RTX 4090: ~2GB VRAM FP16, runs at very high batch size. Strong for code+prose cross-lingual retrieval. task_profile: multilingual_enhanced.

Cohere/Cohere-embed-english-v3.0._gated_live_check: 2026-05-04 — HF API returns gated:false; openly accessible without agree-terms
Cohere/Cohere-embed-english-v3.0.notes: GATED (agree-terms). English-focused sibling of multilingual v3. 1024d. MTEB English SOTA for encoder-only size class. Same VRAM profile as multilingual variant. task_profile: english_commercial.

mistralai/Mistral-Embed._gated_live_check: 2026-05-04 — agree-terms API absent; org-controlled gate confirmed. Run --allow-playwright or visit HF Hub to request access.
mistralai/Mistral-Embed.notes: GATED (agree-terms). Mistral's embedding model — 7B decoder finetuned for retrieval. 8192 ctx. 1024d output. ~14GB VRAM FP16 on RTX 4090 (TRT quantized to INT8 fits <8GB). Strong on code + technical prose. MTEB competitive with much smaller encoders. TEI supports it. task_profile: multilingual_commercial.

NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2.license: other (NVIDIA NV-Community — non-commercial; commercial requires NVIDIA agreement)
NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2._gated_live_check: 2026-05-04 — HF API returns gated:false; openly accessible (NV-Community terms accepted by HF account or not enforced at download level)
NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2._rtx4090_note: ~15GB VRAM FP16; TEI TRT backend quantizes to INT8 at ~8GB. RTX 4090 24GB runs FP16 comfortably with bs=8. Designed specifically for NVIDIA hardware — Flash Attn 2 path, cuBLAS GEMM. Best MTEB score of any model in registry (69.32 as of 2026-05-04).
NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2._strategic_vantage: HARDWARE_OPTIMIZED_TRAINSTOP — see top-level hardware_optimized + hardware_optimized_rationale. This is the designated G7 GOLD model for RTX 4090 + TensorRT systems.
NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2._schema_v4_compat: Dim-truncation path available: NV-Embed-v2 4096d output can be truncated to 1024d at inference time (TEI truncation or manual slice). DDL_VEC FLOAT[1024] and schema_version=4 are preserved. Native 4096d requires schema_version_required=6 and DDL_VEC FLOAT[4096]. Recommend schema v4 truncation path for zero-rebuild-cost activation.
NVIDIA/NV-Embed-v2.notes: HARDWARE-OPTIMIZED TRAINSTOP. MTEB 69.32 (registry best at inception 2026-05-04; open-source SOTA has advanced — see anno_2026_gold_open). 7B Llama-3 decoder with latent attention pooling. 4096d native; schema v4 compatible via 1024d TEI truncation. 32k ctx. NVIDIA hardware advantage: TRT backend, Flash Attn 2, cuBLAS GEMM, INT8 quantization. task_profile: high_accuracy. HF true repo ID: nvidia/NV-Embed-v2 (lowercase). License: cc-by-nc-4.0 (non-commercial).

Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct.notes: ANNO 2026 audit: Apache-2.0, NOT gated, 3.4M downloads. GTE (General Text Embeddings) on Qwen2-7B base. Updated Mar 2025. Strong MTEB — pre-dates Qwen3 series. TEI-compatible. 3584d native (schema v6). For schema v4: truncate to 1024d. task_profile: strong open alternative to NV-Embed-v2.

Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2.5-7B-instruct._gated_live_check: 2026-05-05 — HF API returns 403 (Authentication required). Org-controlled gate or auto agree-terms. Run gating_queue Tier 1 to test.
Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2.5-7B-instruct._strategic_vantage: ANNO_2026_GATED_GOLD — likely MTEB-strongest model once ungated. gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct successor on Qwen2.5 base. See gating_queue for ungate sequence.
Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2.5-7B-instruct.notes: GATED. ANNO 2026 GOLD CANDIDATE. Qwen2.5-base upgrade over gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct. Auth-locked (403 on HF API 2026-05-05). Ungate via: uv run scripts/embed_gate_accept.py --model-id Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2.5-7B-instruct. If Tier 1 fails: --allow-playwright. task_profile: anno_2026_gated_gold.

NovaSearch/stella_en_1.5B_v5.notes: ANNO 2026 audit. MIT license, NOT gated. 1.5B params — strong MTEB for size. 131k context (!). ONNX available (TEI-compatible). 2.5M downloads. arxiv:2412.19048. task_profile: compact_mit. Good fit for RTX 4090 at high batch sizes due to small param count. Updated Jul 2025.

NovaSearch/stella_en_400M_v5.notes: ANNO 2026 audit. MIT license, NOT gated. 435M params. 18.6M downloads — most-downloaded in ANNO 2026 live set. ONNX, TEI-compatible. 131k context. Efficiency tier: fastest on CPU/GPU, highest throughput. arxiv:2412.19048. Updated Jul 2025. task_profile: efficiency_onnx. Zero schema migration needed (1024d, schema v4).

intfloat/e5-mistral-7b-instruct._live_check: 2026-05-05 — MIT license, NOT gated, 5.9M downloads, last updated Apr 2026 (active maintenance).
intfloat/e5-mistral-7b-instruct.notes: ANNO 2026 audit. MIT license (permissive — commercial OK). NOT gated. 7B Mistral finetuned for retrieval. 5.9M downloads. Updated Apr 2026 — actively maintained. 4096d (schema v6); truncate to 1024d for schema v4. arxiv:2401.00368. task_profile: open_mit_large. Strong baseline for tasks requiring large-context commercial use.

Salesforce/SFR-Embedding-2_R.notes: ANNO 2026 audit. CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial only). NOT gated. 2.4M downloads. Salesforce's strong embedding model on Mistral-7B. Updated Feb 2025. 4096d (schema v6). Competitive MTEB. Not suitable for commercial session-data embedding without license review.
